dasboard-backup-li1: If you delete or uninstall Facturalo, you lose the data.
dashboard-backup-p: We remind you that you have Facturalo installed on your PC, therefore the data (invoices, customers, etc...) are stored on your PC and only on your PC. Make regular backups and keep those copies away from your PC.
finished-cron: Finished Facturalo cron execution. Time needed: %timeNeeded% seconds, memory: %memoryUsed%

meta-description: Facturalo: facturación sencilla para pymes y autónomos, por RED TELECOM.

register-install-ad-p: Get one month of PRO sponsorship by registering your Facturalo installation (only the first time). You will be able to download one of the exclusive plugins for sponsors (see the list of sponsor plugins).
registered-installation-claim-p: Installation registered successfully. To finish, press the finalize button to link it to your facturalo.redtelecom.app account.

updates-available-p: There are updates available for Facturalo. Please click on the updater and download the new version. Updates fix bugs and add new features.
fecha-factura-futura: An invoice cannot be issued with a date later than today (%fecha%). Fix the date so the invoice numbering and sequence are not altered.
